title: pkg/testutils: Implement DiffTest struct and RunDiffTests (prd001 R1-R4)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (full PRD for pkg/testutils -- DiffTest struct, binary execution, comparison, normalization)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component description and role in the pipeline)
  - go.mod (module path for package imports)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct, Normalize type, RunDiffTests entry point, binary execution, comparison logic, TimestampNormalizer, ComposeNormalizers

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Define DiffTest struct with fields: Name (string, used as subtest name per prd001-testutils R3.6), Args ([]string), Stdin ([]byte, nil means binary receives no stdin per prd001-testutils R1.2), Env ([]string, nil means inherit test process environment per prd001-testutils R1.3), ExitCode (int, expected exit code per prd001-testutils R1.1), WorkDir (string, empty means use per-test temp directory per prd001-testutils R2.5), and Normalize ([]Normalize, nil or empty means no normalization per prd001-testutils R4.3). Define Normalize as func([]byte) []byte per prd001-testutils R1.4."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) that iterates the test slice and runs each DiffTest as a named subtest via t.Run using DiffTest.Name. Per prd001-testutils R2.1, R3.6, and AC1."
  - id: R3
    text: "For each DiffTest, execute both goBinary and refBinary with identical Args, Stdin, and Env. Capture stdout, stderr, and exit code from each binary independently. When WorkDir is empty, run both binaries in a per-test temporary directory. Must not write any output to the test process stdout or stderr during a passing test run. Per prd001-testutils R2.1-R2.2, R2.4-R2.5."
  - id: R4
    text: "Impose a configurable timeout on each binary invocation using context.WithTimeout. The default timeout must be 10 seconds. The test fails with a clear timeout message if either binary exceeds the timeout. Per prd001-testutils R2.3."
  - id: R5
    text: "Apply the DiffTest.Normalize functions in order to both binaries' stdout and stderr before comparison. Compare normalized stdout byte-for-byte, compare normalized stderr byte-for-byte, and compare exit codes exactly. Any difference must be reported as a test failure. Per prd001-testutils R3.1-R3.4."
  - id: R6
    text: "On divergence, report in the failure message: the DiffTest Args, the Stdin content (truncated to 256 bytes if longer), the reference binary stdout, the Go binary stdout, the reference binary stderr, the Go binary stderr, and both exit codes. Per prd001-testutils R3.5."
  - id: R7
    text: "Implement TimestampNormalizer as a Normalize function that replaces common strftime timestamp patterns with the fixed placeholder string 'TIMESTAMP'. Must handle patterns matching the default ts format '%b %d %H:%M:%S' (e.g., 'Feb 19 12:34:56') and HH:MM:SS elapsed time formats. Per prd001-testutils R4.2 and AC3."
  - id: R8
    text: "Implement ComposeNormalizers(normalizers ...Normalize) Normalize that returns a single Normalize function applying the given normalizers in order. When called with no arguments, returns nil. Per prd001-testutils R4.1 and R4.3."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "Primary exported type is DiffTest; primary source file is difftest.go (named after primary exported type, not package name, per project naming convention)."
  - id: D2
    text: "Entry point signature is RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) per prd001-testutils AC1."
  - id: D3
    text: "Timeout is implemented via context.WithTimeout wrapping exec.CommandContext; default is 10 seconds per prd001-testutils R2.3."
  - id: D4
    text: "DiffTest.Normalize is []Normalize (a slice applied in order) per prd001-testutils R4.3. Nil or empty slice means no normalization is applied."
  - id: D5
    text: "When DiffTest.WorkDir is empty, both binaries run in a per-test temporary directory created via t.TempDir() per prd001-testutils R2.5."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "DiffTest struct and Normalize function type are defined with all fields specified in prd001-testutils R1.1-R1.4."
  - id: AC2
    text: "RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) is callable from a TestXxx function with no other setup per prd001-testutils AC1."
  - id: AC3
    text: "Binary execution captures stdout, stderr, and exit code independently. No output is written to the test process during a passing run per prd001-testutils R2.4."
  - id: AC4
    text: "Timeout defaults to 10 seconds. A DiffTest exceeding the timeout fails with a clear timeout message per prd001-testutils R2.3 and AC5."
  - id: AC5
    text: "Comparison applies normalization then diffs byte-for-byte. Divergence report includes args, stdin (truncated to 256 bytes), both stdout, both stderr, and both exit codes per prd001-testutils R3.1-R3.5."
  - id: AC6
    text: "TimestampNormalizer replaces strftime-formatted timestamps with 'TIMESTAMP' placeholder. ComposeNormalizers chains multiple normalizers in order per prd001-testutils R4.2-R4.3 and AC3."
  - id: AC7
    text: "All pkg/testutils code compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint per prd001-testutils AC6."
